lyrics: I look
across the river where the factory
used to stand    And I curse
the people voting   for the ruin
of this land
They tell me on the screen   that the neighbor
is to blame   That the folks
across the county line are playing
a wicked game
I tighten up my fist and I draw
a heavy line
Thinking I am protecting   what is
rightfully mine
On the        other side of town,
they are holding the same worn
out hand On the   other side of town,
they are watching the very same hourglass
sand We are   throwing our stones at the mirror
on the wall While the men who own the quarry are waiting
for us to fall
Yeah we are fighting in the mud,
staring       each other down
From the other side of town
I stare out of the window
at the closed   up avenue
And I blame the people wearing
red for what   the bosses do
I bought the angry story
that they sell us every night
That the      enemy is breathing
on the other side of the fight
We are standing in the breadline
with our shoulders   side by side
But we are too blinded by the colors
to cross the great
divide
On the other side of town, they are holding
the same worn out hand
On the other side of town,   they are watching the very
same hourglass sand
We are throwing our stones at the mirror on the wall
While the men who own the quarry are waiting   for us to fall
Yeah we are
fighting in the mud, staring
each other down
From the other side of town
They want us pointing fingers
Because if we ever turn around
They drew a line between us so we
could not form a crowd!
On the other side of town,   we are holding the
same worn     out hand
On the other side of town,   we are watching the very
same hourglass sand We were throwing
our stones at the mirror on the wall
While the men who own the quarry were waiting for us to fall
Now I am
looking through the fence, finally
breaking it   down
To the other side of town
The           anger was real.
But           the target
was wrong.
